question: According to the Paradise criteria, tonsillectomy is indicated after 7 episodes of tonsillitis in one year, 5 episodes per year for two consecutive years, or 3 episodes per year for three consecutive years.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The Paradise criteria for tonsillectomy are: 7 or more episodes in one year, 5 or more per year for 2 consecutive years, or 3 or more per year for 3 consecutive years — provided each episode is properly documented.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The Paradise criteria (7/1, 5/2, 3/3) are the internationally recognised thresholds for tonsillectomy in recurrent tonsillitis. Each episode must be documented with at least one of: fever >38.3°C, cervical lymphadenopathy, tonsillar exudate, or positive Group A Streptococcal culture.
